VA:invasive.says: Invasive plant in Virginia: from January 1, 2027, a store may sell it for outdoor use only with a sign near it that identifies it as invasive; the Commissioner must stop the sale of any without one (Code of Virginia § 3.2-3801.1)
VA:invasive.title: Virginia noxious weeds (2VAC5-317) and invasive plant signage law (Code of Virginia § 3.2-3801.1)
VA:invasive.edition: Virginia Administrative Code, 2VAC5-317 as last amended effective July 4, 2024 (Virginia Register Vol. 40, Iss. 21); Code of Virginia §§ 3.2-800 to 3.2-809 as amended through 2026, and § 3.2-3801.1 (2025, cc. 393, 409), effective January 1, 2027; both as printed by the General Assembly's Legislative Information System on 2026-10-31

VA:tier3.says: Noxious weed in Virginia: a Tier 3 weed, present in the state and not feasible to eradicate or suppress; it may not be moved (shipped, carried or otherwise transported) without a certificate or permit from the Commissioner (2VAC5-317-20, -30)
VA:tier3.title: Virginia noxious weeds (2VAC5-317) and invasive plant signage law (Code of Virginia § 3.2-3801.1)
VA:tier3.edition: Virginia Administrative Code, 2VAC5-317 as last amended effective July 4, 2024 (Virginia Register Vol. 40, Iss. 21); Code of Virginia §§ 3.2-800 to 3.2-809 as amended through 2026, and § 3.2-3801.1 (2025, cc. 393, 409), effective January 1, 2027; both as printed by the General Assembly's Legislative Information System on 2026-10-31

VA:tier2.says: Noxious weed in Virginia: a Tier 2 weed, present in the state and feasible to eradicate or suppress; it may not be moved (shipped, carried or otherwise transported) without a certificate or permit from the Commissioner, who may destroy or seize it, or stop its sale or delivery (2VAC5-317-20, -30, -80)
VA:tier2.title: Virginia noxious weeds (2VAC5-317) and invasive plant signage law (Code of Virginia § 3.2-3801.1)
